list.name: task
list.label: Task
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT task_id FROM runs ORDER BY task_id
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT task_id FROM runs ORDER BY task_id

list.name: config
list.label: Config
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT config_id FROM runs ORDER BY config_id
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT config_id FROM runs ORDER BY config_id

targets.queryText: SELECT count(*) AS builds FROM chromium_builds JOIN runs ON runs.run_id = chromium_builds.run_id WHERE runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote})
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT count(*) AS builds FROM chromium_builds JOIN runs ON runs.run_id = chromium_builds.run_id WHERE runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote})

targets.queryText: SELECT count(*) AS passed FROM chromium_builds JOIN runs ON runs.run_id = chromium_builds.run_id WHERE chromium_builds.status = 'passed' AND runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote})
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT count(*) AS passed FROM chromium_builds JOIN runs ON runs.run_id = chromium_builds.run_id WHERE chromium_builds.status = 'passed' AND runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote})

targets.queryText: SELECT count(*) AS cancelled FROM chromium_builds JOIN runs ON runs.run_id = chromium_builds.run_id WHERE chromium_builds.status = 'cancelled' AND runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote})

panels.title: Still building
panels.description: A row stays building when the process is still running, or when it never got to write the result.

targets.queryText: SELECT count(*) AS building FROM chromium_builds JOIN runs ON runs.run_id = chromium_builds.run_id WHERE chromium_builds.status = 'building' AND runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote})
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT count(*) AS building FROM chromium_builds JOIN runs ON runs.run_id = chromium_builds.run_id WHERE chromium_builds.status = 'building' AND runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote})

targets.queryText: SELECT avg(chromium_builds.duration_ms) AS duration FROM chromium_builds JOIN runs ON runs.run_id = chromium_builds.run_id WHERE chromium_builds.status = 'passed' AND chromium_builds.duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote})
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT avg(chromium_builds.duration_ms) AS duration FROM chromium_builds JOIN runs ON runs.run_id = chromium_builds.run_id WHERE chromium_builds.status = 'passed' AND chromium_builds.duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote})

panels.title: Avg passed duration by task / config

targets.queryText: SELECT runs.task_id || ' / ' || runs.config_id AS setup, avg(chromium_builds.duration_ms) / 1000.0 AS seconds FROM chromium_builds JOIN runs ON runs.run_id = chromium_builds.run_id WHERE chromium_builds.status = 'passed' AND chromium_builds.duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) GROUP BY runs.task_id, runs.config_id ORDER BY seconds DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT runs.task_id || ' / ' || runs.config_id AS setup, avg(chromium_builds.duration_ms) / 1000.0 AS seconds FROM chromium_builds JOIN runs ON runs.run_id = chromium_builds.run_id WHERE chromium_builds.status = 'passed' AND chromium_builds.duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) GROUP BY runs.task_id, runs.config_id ORDER BY seconds DESC

panels.title: Builds (newest first)
panels.description: Every Chromium build started from the Runs tab. duration is the whole build. error is set when it failed or was cancelled.

targets.queryText: SELECT runs.task_id, runs.config_id, chromium_builds.target, chromium_builds.host, chromium_builds.status, chromium_builds.started_at, chromium_builds.duration_ms AS duration, chromium_builds.error, chromium_builds.run_id FROM chromium_builds JOIN runs ON runs.run_id = chromium_builds.run_id WHERE runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) ORDER BY chromium_builds.started_at DESC LIMIT 200
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT runs.task_id, runs.config_id, chromium_builds.target, chromium_builds.host, chromium_builds.status, chromium_builds.started_at, chromium_builds.duration_ms AS duration, chromium_builds.error, chromium_builds.run_id FROM chromium_builds JOIN runs ON runs.run_id = chromium_builds.run_id WHERE runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) ORDER BY chromium_builds.started_at DESC LIMIT 200
